newsitem.title: USA: Enhance names Klein, Sherman to new posts.
newsitem.headline: Enhance names Klein, Sherman to new posts.

text.p: Enhance Finance Services Group Inc said Tuesday it named Steven Klein head of marketing for financial guaranty business and Kenneth Sherman chief information officer.
Klein left Financial Guaranty Insurance Co to join Enhance as a senior vice president, and will also be responsible for product development.
Sherman's post is newly created. He was previously responsible for marketing Enhance's financial guaranty business.

"Steve Klein's extensive background in marketing and new product development in the municipal markets will enable us to further improve client service in our financial guaranty reinsurance business and grow our niche direct municipal business," Daniel Gross, Enhance's president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Klein, 42, was previously senior products manager at FGIC, a unit of GE Capital Services. GE Capital is a subsidiary of General Electric Co.
Sherman, 43, joined Enhance in 1990 from Marine Midland Bank, where he was a director in the corporate finance division.
